::: {.intro-block}
I am an Assistant Professor of Statistics at California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo, with affiliated faculty status in the Data Science Program. My work sits at the intersection of **statistics education**, **data science pedagogy**, and **software for teaching** — turning real, culturally relevant data into interactive tools that help students build genuine understanding.

My research centers on three connected frameworks: **Culturally Relevant Data (CRD)**, the **Extraction–Transformation–Visualization (ETV)** model, and the **Library-Focused Method (LFM)**. Alongside this, I develop R packages and Shiny applications, and I serve as incoming Chair of **SIGMAA SDS-Ed**, the MAA's Special Interest Group on Statistics and Data Science Education.
:::
